label: Standard
description: Standard single-game ticket sold at face value or with a promo

label: Season package
description: Game included in a season-ticket package (one SEASON order covers all 41 home games)

label: Group
description: Group sales, 10+ seats in one order, group discount

label: Complimentary
description: Complimentary ticket, sold_price_usd = 0, NOT a sale

label: Resale
description: Ticket resold by a fan on the Resale marketplace; HoopsPass earns fee + commission only

label: All-Star
description: HoopsPass Rewards - 15+ games or season ticket holder

label: MVP
description: HoopsPass Rewards - invitation only, top 1% spenders

label: Completed
description: Paid and fulfilled; the only status that counts as a sale

label: Refunded
description: Fully refunded after purchase; tickets voided

label: Cancelled
description: Cancelled before payment settled; tickets voided

label: Chargeback
description: Payment disputed and reversed by the bank; tickets voided

label: Single game
description: Order for one specific game (orders.game_id is set)

label: Season package
description: Season-ticket package; orders.game_id is NULL, game is on each ticket

label: Group
description: Group sales order for one game

label: Playoffs
description: Playoff game (rounds R1, R2, CONF_FINALS, FINALS)
